title: Conversation Summaries, Codex Diffs, and Custom Review Models
fullTitle: 0.22.6: Conversation Summaries, Codex Diffs, and Custom Review Models
description: Conductor 0.22.6 changelog - Conversation Summaries, Codex Diffs, and Custom Review Models
summary: You can now attach a summary of your previous chats in new tabs.
html:
You can now attach a summary of your previous chats in new tabs.

Conductor now shows Codex's changes after each turn.

Also, select your default model and thinking level for reviews.

Fixes

  • Fix the retry button
  • Prevent the escape key from cancelling the agent while editing the branch name
